text_block_list.text:
On our way back from an outing with Nice 
Nature...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hey, we still have time, so... 
Um............ wanna go see some fish?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
The lady at the fishmonger told me, "Take 
a look with me!"
choice_data_list: Of course I'll come with you!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Alrighty, guess we should get going.

Wondering if there was a particular fish 
she was looking for at the fishmonger's, I 
followed along...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, look at 'em swimmin' around~. So many 
delicious-lookin' fish swarmin' 
everywhere~.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Aha.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yeah, yeah! I get it. Like, "There 
must've been a better way to invite 
them~," right?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's Nature, after all? Cute 
invitations just aren't her style.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
“Still, the lady went out of her way to 
give us coupons so the two of us could 
take a break...”

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I swear I wasn't trying to trick you or 
anything like that. Seriously.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
O-Ooh... Is that what they call mature 
composure? Impressive...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Well, okay. As long as you're not 
bothered by it, that's fine."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
So, this might not make up for it, but... 
let's watch whatever you want, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I looked it up and saw they had all kinds 
of fun things going on. As expected of a 
classic da—outing spot, huh?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
The jellyfish exhibit, the stingrays... 
the sea bream... They all looked pretty 
delicious.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah, going with the classics, maybe a 
dolphin show?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...Nah, watching something that cute with 
me would be kinda weird, huh?"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'll leave it up to you, Trainer! 
What's the plan?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: "...Hey. Were you even listening to me?"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I knew that. But that's not what I 
meant, you know?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"No, well... I was the one who said I'd 
adjust to you, after all~."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Alright, alright. If it helps you unwind, 
sure.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I can't do cute reactions like "Kyaah~" or 
anything, so keep that in mind.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, that's one lively dolphin~. ...Wait, 
whoa?! H-Hey, water! The water is—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Gyaaaah!!?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Dammit... That splash has gotta be against 
the rules.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"I had no idea dolphin shows were such a 
thrilling experience..."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Geez... Forget an 'eek!', I screamed 
straight from the bottom of my lungs.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Well, yeah. Enjoying things like 
this is just like us, huh.

Having enjoyed the aquarium with Nice 
Nature, we were able to take a great, 
refreshing breather.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ooh, that sounds like fun!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
And they're calling it the "Scariest of 
All." Let's see what it's really made of~

And so, I moved over to the exhibition 
area with Nice Nature, but...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ka!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: S O C U T E ! !

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa~~~!! Look at those round, beady 
eyes! It's called a "flapjack octopus"~!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Haaah...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Th-That's totally cheating! Calling it the 
scariest ever when it's all just cute 
stuff like this!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Dammit... ...So cute.
choice_data_list:
The fish over there looks pretty good 
too...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Whoa, for real! It's so ugly-cute~~!

Having enjoyed the aquarium with Nice 
Nature, we were able to take a great, 
refreshing breather.
